annotation.title_clean: ISO/IEC 5259-5:2025 - Artificial intelligence — Data quality for analytics and machine learning (ML) — Part 5: Data quality governance framework
annotation.title_en: ISO/IEC 5259-5:2025 - Artificial intelligence — Data quality for analytics and machine learning (ML) — Part 5: Data quality governance framework
annotation.summary_en: ISO store page for ISO/IEC 5259-5:2025, a data quality governance framework for analytics and machine learning. It gives governing bodies and senior management a structure to direct and monitor data quality across the data life cycle. It sets out the "why" and "who", not the "how". It is general AI, with no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Governance framework for overseeing data quality in analytics and ML
Targets governing bodies and senior management
Defines responsibilities and embeds quality controls across the data life cycle
Complements ISO/IEC 5259-3 and 5259-4 on management and operational processes
Applies to analytics, ML and any system where data quality is critical
